# Source: onesa-mobile/scripts/ci/workflows/onesa-mobile-native-compile.yml
# Source SHA256: 9381f7b834336be5914694cafaaa0f89ce36719ecc1faacb56eb8506c0365558
name: Onesa Mobile native compilation
'on':
  push:
    branches:
    - main
    paths:
    - onesa-mobile/onesa-mobile-frontend/mobile/**
    - .github/workflows/onesa-mobile-native-compile.yml
  pull_request:
    paths:
    - onesa-mobile/onesa-mobile-frontend/mobile/**
    - .github/workflows/onesa-mobile-native-compile.yml
  workflow_dispatch: null
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: onesa-mobile-native-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  android:
    name: Android debug compile (no release signing)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 40
    env:
      CI: '1'
      EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY: '1'
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: onesa-mobile/onesa-mobile-frontend/mobile
    steps:
    - name: Verify hosted execution, visibility and included-allowance policy
      env:
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        EXPECTED_PRIVATE: ${{ github.event.repository.private }}
        PRIVATE_VALIDATION_ENABLED: ${{ vars.ONESA_PRIVATE_HOSTED_VALIDATION_ENABLED }}
      run: |
        test "$RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT" = github-hosted
        actual=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --jq ".private")
        test "$actual" = "$EXPECTED_PRIVATE" || { echo "Repository visibility changed"; exit 1; }
        if [ "$actual" = true ] && [ "$PRIVATE_VALIDATION_ENABLED" != true ]; then
          echo "Private hosted verification requires explicit included-allowance opt-in"
          exit 1
        fi
      working-directory: .
    - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803
      with:
        persist-credentials: false
    - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38
      with:
        node-version: 24.22.1
        cache: npm
        cache-dependency-path: onesa-mobile/onesa-mobile-frontend/mobile/package-lock.json
    - run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
    - name: Select the runner's JDK 17
      run: |
        test -d "$JAVA_HOME_17_X64"
        echo "JAVA_HOME=$JAVA_HOME_17_X64" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
        echo "$JAVA_HOME_17_X64/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
    - name: Install the SDK versions pinned by React Native 0.88
      run: |
        test -x "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager"
        "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" 'platforms;android-37.0' 'build-tools;37.0.0' 'ndk;27.1.12297006'
        # API 37 is published with a .0 suffix; RN's integer compileSdk expects this alias.
        # https://github.com/actions/runner-images/issues/13859
        test -f "$ANDROID_HOME/platforms/android-37.0/android.jar"
        if [ ! -e "$ANDROID_HOME/platforms/android-37" ]; then
          ln -s android-37.0 "$ANDROID_HOME/platforms/android-37"
        fi
    - name: Compile the arm64 Android debug application
      run: ./android/gradlew -p android :app:assembleDebug -PreactNativeArchitectures=arm64-v8a --no-daemon --console=plain
    - name: Confirm native APK output without uploading signing material
      run: test -s android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
    - name: Retain the arm64 Android debug APK for pilot installation
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9
      with:
        name: onesa-mobile-android-arm64-debug-${{ github.sha }}
        path: onesa-mobile/onesa-mobile-frontend/mobile/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
        if-no-files-found: error
        retention-days: 7
        compression-level: 0
  ios:
    name: iOS simulator compile (unsigned)
    runs-on: macos-26
    timeout-minutes: 50
    env:
      CI: '1'
      EXPO_NO_TELEMETRY: '1'
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: onesa-mobile/onesa-mobile-frontend/mobile
    steps:
    - name: Verify hosted execution, visibility and included-allowance policy
      env:
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        EXPECTED_PRIVATE: ${{ github.event.repository.private }}
        PRIVATE_VALIDATION_ENABLED: ${{ vars.ONESA_PRIVATE_HOSTED_VALIDATION_ENABLED }}
      run: |
        test "$RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT" = github-hosted
        actual=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --jq ".private")
        test "$actual" = "$EXPECTED_PRIVATE" || { echo "Repository visibility changed"; exit 1; }
        if [ "$actual" = true ] && [ "$PRIVATE_VALIDATION_ENABLED" != true ]; then
          echo "Private hosted verification requires explicit included-allowance opt-in"
          exit 1
        fi
      working-directory: .
    - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803
      with:
        persist-credentials: false
    - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38
      with:
        node-version: 24.22.1
        cache: npm
        cache-dependency-path: onesa-mobile/onesa-mobile-frontend/mobile/package-lock.json
    - run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
    - name: Record installed native toolchain versions
      run: |
        xcodebuild -version
        pod --version
    - name: Prepare Xcode environment from the public template
      run: npm run prepare:ios
    - name: Install generated native module pods
      run: pod install --project-directory=ios
    - name: Compile the unsigned iPhone and iPad simulator target
      run: xcodebuild -workspace ios/OnesaMobilePreview.xcworkspace -scheme OnesaMobilePreview -configuration Debug
        -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath .validation/ios-build
        CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
    - name: Confirm native simulator app output
      run: test -d .validation/ios-build/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/OnesaMobilePreview.app
    - name: Archive only the unsigned simulator application
      run: |
        mkdir -p native-artifacts
        tar -czf native-artifacts/OnesaMobilePreview-simulator.tar.gz -C .validation/ios-build/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator OnesaMobilePreview.app
    - name: Retain the unsigned iOS simulator application
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9
      with:
        name: onesa-mobile-ios-simulator-unsigned-${{ github.sha }}
        path: onesa-mobile/onesa-mobile-frontend/mobile/native-artifacts/OnesaMobilePreview-simulator.tar.gz
        if-no-files-found: error
        retention-days: 7
        compression-level: 0
